csv_scope_of_work: Design services for The Boone County Parks and Recreation Department invites proposals from qualified vendors for the design, fabrication and installation of six (6) new informational kiosks at Central Park in Boone County, KY, and one additional unit at England-Idlewild Park in Burlington, KY. These kiosks are intended to replace the existing ones, which have been in place for over two decades and are now in poor condition. Interested vendors are welcome to visit the sites prior to submitting a proposal in order to become more familiar with the locations and existing structures.
